newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may lower Hokkaido Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may lower Hokkaido Bank ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had placed Hokkaido Bank Ltd's long- and short-term deposit and financial strength ratings under review for possible downgrade.
The ratings under review are the bank's Baa3 long-term desposit rating, Prime-3 short-term deposit rating and E+ bank financial strength rating.

The review will focus on the viability of Hokkaido Bank's efforts to solve its serious asset quality problems as well as on the bank's diminishing competitiveness in Japan's most overbanked market, Moody's said.
